map_features.note: Editorial point on the southern Portuguese slope near the float-observed Mediterranean Undercurrent; not a source core position, path, or length endpoint.
map_features.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

map_features.note: Declared southwestern Iberian lower-core reach from the AMUSE launch neighborhood near 8.5 W, 36.5 N, westward around Cape St. Vincent and northward to an OSW western-slope gate at 38.2 N near the Lisbon/Setubal canyon region. Excludes upstream Gibraltar gravity-current descent, offshore Mediterranean Water spreading, meddy looping, Estremadura branch dynamics and uncertain farther-north continuity. Not a full-current axis or float trajectory.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

scope_notes.label: Lower-core studied reach versus broader Mediterranean Water spreading
scope_notes.summary: AMUSE lower-core reach around Cape St. Vincent remains separate from Gibraltar density flow, offshore water spreading and meddy loops. Regional 30 km and 10 km width metrics do not form a seasonal range; whole-current endpoints unresolved.

widths.boundary_rule: Mean velocity maximum to offshore zero crossing only. Inshore fall to zero is not robust in the source; do not interpret as full paired-boundary width or double the value.
widths.extraction_method: Approximate prose value transcribed with its detailed boundary definition; no figure digitized.
widths.geographic_scope: Southern Portuguese slope, Region 1 of Figures 6-7; not the entire undercurrent.
widths.layer: Nonmeddy lower-core RAFOS observations restricted to 950-1250 dbar.
widths.name: Mediterranean Undercurrent
widths.range_interpretation: No source-supplied width uncertainty. These different metrics and sampling supports do not establish a seasonal 10-30 km range.
remaining_gates: Review boundary definition and regional/layer sampling.
Obtain comparable repeated observations before seasonal animation or annual range.
Canonical measurement admission and release review.
widths.section_orientation: Mean zonal velocity versus meridional distance from 36.8 N, binned at 10 km.
widths.source_citation: Bower, Serra and Ambar (2002), Structure of the Mediterranean Undercurrent and Mediterranean Water spreading around the southwestern Iberian Peninsula, doi:10.1029/2001JC001007.
widths.source_quality_note: Reported 0.1 m/s standard deviation describes velocity variability, not width uncertainty.
widths.time_convention: AMUSE ensemble; floats deployed May 1993-March 1994 and tracked up to 11 months. Launch dates are not observation end dates or an annual climatology.
